mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_TYPE FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID
SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_TYPE FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POSTS ( USER_ID, TEAM_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY_ID ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{categoryId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POSTS SET TEAM_ID = #{teamId}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_BLIND = 'N' AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
UPDATE POSTS SET IS_BLIND = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_BLIND = 'N' AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
UPDATE POSTS SET LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT + 1 WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND IS_BLIND = 'N' AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
UPDATE POSTS SET LIKE_COUNT = GREATEST(LIKE_COUNT - 1, 0) WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND IS_BLIND = 'N' AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT c.COMMENT_ID, c.POST_ID, c.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, c.P_COMMENT_ID, c.CONTENT, c.IS_BLIND, c.IS_DELETED, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT FROM COMMENTS c JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = c.USER_ID WHERE c.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY NVL(c.P_COMMENT_ID, c.COMMENT_ID), CASE WHEN c.P_COMMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.CREATED_AT, c.COMMENT_ID

SELECT c.COMMENT_ID, c.POST_ID, c.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, c.P_COMMENT_ID, c.CONTENT, c.IS_BLIND, c.IS_DELETED, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT FROM COMMENTS c JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = c.USER_ID WHERE c.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS ( POST_ID, USER_ID, P_COMMENT_ID, CONTENT ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{pCommentId}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT ATTACHMENT_ID, POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT FROM POST_ATTACHMENTS WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATED_AT ASC, ATTACHMENT_ID ASC
SELECT ATTACHMENT_ID, POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT FROM POST_ATTACHMENTS WHERE ATTACHMENT_ID = #{attachmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST_ATTACHMENTS ( POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SORT_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.CONTENT, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.IS_BLIND, p.IS_DELETED, p.CREATED_AT, p.UPDATED_AT FROM POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE p.POST_ID = #{postId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE POSTS SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.IS_BLIND, p.IS_DELETED, p.CREATED_AT FROM POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND p.CATEGORY_ID IN
#{categoryId}
AND p.TEAM_ID IS NULL
AND p.TEAM_ID IS NOT NULL
AND p.TEAM_ID = #{teamId}
AND LOWER(p.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '!'
ORDER BY
p.LIKE_COUNT DESC,
p.VIEW_COUNT DESC,
p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.POST_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
